WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '') AS batting_hand,
           COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_id) AS player_count
    FROM player_award AS pa
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id
    GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '')
), shares AS (
    SELECT batting_hand,
           player_count,
           1.0 * player_count / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_counts
), with_average AS (
    SELECT batting_hand,
           player_count,
           share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT batting_hand,
       player_count,
       share,
       share - average_share AS above_average
FROM with_average
WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: A blank or NULL batting-hand value is represented as the empty string, and each player is counted once regardless of how many award records they have.
